title: Harlem piano school and Cafe Society
summary: He played with Willie the Lion and three boogie-woogie pianists at Cafe Society.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: What about the so-called piano school of Harlem, people like Willie the Lion and Fats Waller and Albert Ammons?
What was that like? Did you work with any of those people? What about Earl "Fatha" Hines?
We played down at Cafe Society together.
I know Willie the Lion Smith; I know him very well.
Willie the Lion Smith - we worked - I don't know, can't anybody play with Willie the Lion. But we had three piano players, three boogie-woogies, down at Cafe Society.
